many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    # rare = less frequent marker color
    rare=min(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); common=max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    half=(W-1)/2
    for i in range(H):
        pos=[(j,g[i][j]) for j in range(W) if g[i][j] not in (bg,)]
        if not pos: continue
        for j,c in pos:
            opp=[p for p in pos if p[1]!=c]
            tgt=None
            if opp:
                # nearest opposite in row (only horizontal rays used)
                candidates=[(abs(p[0]-j),p[0]) for p in opp]
                tgt=min(candidates)[1]
            else:
                tgt=int(round(half)) if j<half else int(round(half))+1
            step=1 if tgt>j else -1
            k=j+step
            while 0<=k<W:
                v=out[i][k]
                if v==bg: out[i][k]=c
                elif v==rare: out[i][k]=4
                else: break
                k+=step
    return out

for pair in [('Demo pair 1 input','Demo pair 1 output'),('Demo pair 2 input','Demo pair 2 output')]:
    gi,go=pair
    pred=solve(G[gi])
    print(pair, pred==G[go], [(i,j,pred[i][j],G[go][i][j]) for i in range(len(pred)) for j in range(len(pred[0])) if pred[i][j]!=G[go][i][j]][:10])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])) if 'json' in dir() else '')

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # border emitters: non-bg cells in first/last column
    for r in range(H):
        for c in (0,W-1):
            v=g[r][c]
            if v==bg: continue
            other=[x for x in others if x!=v][0]
            step=-1 if c==W-1 else 1
            k=c+step
            while 0<=k<W:
                vv=out[r][k]
                if vv==bg:
                    out[r][k]=other
                elif vv!=v:
                    out[r][k]=4
                    break
                else:
                    break
                k+=step
    return out
for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    pred=f(G[name+' input']); go=G[name+' output']
    diff=[(i,j,pred[i][j],go[i][j]) for i in range(len(pred)) for j in range(len(pred[0])) if pred[i][j]!=go[i][j]]
    print(name,'match' if not diff else diff[:10])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
